svg.title: TOPAK H4 — The reference implementation, as deployed in development
svg.desc: mechanism/ runs the admit path end to end for Build's six actions and Run's three: three replicas of one Rust binary, an MCP front door on stdio, an operator socket, a linked Cedar floor, an OPA sidecar with a WASM fallback, and Kafka or an in-memory transport. It carries a launcher and a Run tool host that the dev configuration does not turn on. It is evidence, not the verified object.

text.tspan: The reference implementation, as deployed in development

svg.text: mechanism/ runs the admit path end to end for Build's six actions and Run's three: three replicas of one Rust binary, an MCP front door on stdio, an operator socket, a linked Cedar floor, an OPA sidecar with a WASM fallback, and Kafka or an in-memory transport. It carries a launcher and a Run tool host that the dev configuration does not turn on. It is evidence, not the verified object.

text.tspan: Built at reference · evidence · rung 0 as deployed

svg.text: Rung 0 as deployed: the dev configuration has no contain section, so every lease it issues is rung 0. In its tests the launcher (ADR-0033 A7, pending) issues rung 1 on profiles that declare P3 fail, and rung 3 only SIMULATED under test keys: every principal it serves in earnest is Mediated; it fails assumption of use A1, and no containment theorem describes it. Never promoted: no promotion pipeline exists, and nothing in it is in any TCB. Dev rules are not genesis rules:
dev-init.sh generates keys and writes their secrets to dev/secrets/ in the clear (G6).

Cited like a TLA+ check, by manifest and commit: SHA256SUMS-REF-2026.10.02b, digest 8fa797e317120e54, at c534a42 (ADR-0033 A8, pending; the last inserted addendum is A6, 48f92ab89086adce at dacbb0c). A running program invites being mistaken for the mechanism (ToO §15).
Any MCP-capable agent. Byzantine at every position (ADR-0007).
Not confined: an agent process with a shell, a network stack or a filesystem
bypasses the front door entirely (G1, the sandbox gap). A guest the node launches
is the other way in: no token, stdio only (C5).
One process per session; crate topak-mcp (rmcp server), inside the topak binary.
Its tools are exactly the seat's alphabet: Build's six (ADR-0022 §1) or Run's three
(ADR-0040 §1). Each call becomes one typed action; unknown or malformed calls
It grants nothing: every call is decided by the replica.
PROVISIONAL (operator authentication): the socket is protected by file mode
0600 only. Issuances and break-glass approvals carry their own signatures; grants,
revocations and gate evidence do not (G5).
Helpers: topak keygen, topak sign, topak tool-digest, topak check-rules
Signed by a break-glass roster key
Unsigned; refused unless the profile is
appraises, and orders the grant with
the appraisal in it (A7, pending; needs
run/n1/agent.sock, mode 0660; a bearer token names seat, lease, epoch; a launched lease mints none
the eight steps of D1, in topak-node over topak-core
topak-floor: Cedar linked; refuses to start unless the floor, schema and values bytes match the gated digests
topak-bundle: loads bundles_dir only under signatures verifying against bundle_keys; sidecar client, WASM fallback
topak-paxos driven by driver.rs: persists fsynced before any send
run/n1/wal.jsonl: promises and accepted votes, durable before replies
every 250 ms, proposes EndRound(Expired) for leases this replica saw expire
workspaces/ (not replicated, G9); archive.jsonl, a projection of the log, not the archive
mechanism/launch.rs over topak-contain: launch, appraise, grant, bridge; renews against the same guest; destroys it when the round ends (A7, pending). Off in dev: no
topak-contain wasmtool: a Wasm module per call whose one network capability is its declared target (A8, pending). None in dev: wasm_tools is empty

text.tspan: The eight crates, and the process each runs in

svg.text: Replica: Paxos driver, WAL, admit pipeline, effects, the two sockets, the topak CLI
Types, lease (ADR-0031), rules floor (ADR-0026), tally (ADR-0024), lift, composition, replicated
Sans-IO crash-fault Multi-Paxos plus a Voting ghost
Cedar engine with floor/genesis-floor.cedar, genesis.cedarschema and the values file
OPA sidecar client; local OPA WASM fallback bound to the lease's bundle; signature check
topak node; talks to the OPA sidecar
Round topics over rskafka, or in memory
The alphabet as MCP tools (rmcp server); downstream tool host (rmcp client)
server half in topak mcp; tool-host half in topak node
The launcher's backends (host process, Docker, SIMULATED rung 3), appraisal, bridge; the Run
tool host for Wasm modules; topak-demo-guest
topak node; each guest is its own process or container

One binary, topak, carries every crate; topak-demo-tool is a second binary in topak-node, the downstream tool the dev configuration allowlists; topak-demo-guest, in topak-contain, is the scripted occupant the tests
Same binary, same rules, params, corpus and bundles; its own run/n2/ data dir, WAL and sockets.
Same binary, same rules, params, corpus and bundles; its own run/n3/ data dir, WAL and sockets.

text.tspan: Paxos over TCP among n1, n2, n3

svg.text: Unauthenticated JSON frames over plain TCP, best-effort: Paxos tolerates loss, duplication and reordering (net.rs). PROVISIONAL (replica authentication): mutual TLS is required before this leaves a lab (G5;
Fault model: crash-recovery, not Byzantine (ADR-0033 §3). A compromised replica could propose admits no floor evaluated.
No snapshots and no compaction: the log, the chosen map, the dedupe set and the WAL grow without bound (G14). Every admit waits for a consensus round.
docker compose up opa: host :18181 → container :8181, serving bundles/${TOPAK_BUNDLE}.tar.gz.
Optional: dev-init.sh --opa points every replica at it; without it, the local WASM engine only.
Its answer counts only from the lease's revision, and only if that revision verified (ADR-0044 §3).
docker compose up kafka: :9092; dev-init.sh --kafka sets brokers 127.0.0.1:9092, replication 1.
Without it: in-memory transport. Round topics topak.<chain>.<domain>.<seat>.e<epoch>.r<round> and their .after
Transport only; ADR-0005 is Proposed, and the K row is carried as a debt (ADR-0033 §2).
Spawned per call by the tool host over stdio, as wordcount@<digest>; digest = SHA-256(binary digest ‖ canonical JSON of its
MCP input schema), both halves checked on every call.
Cleared environment, the workspace as working directory, and nothing more: hermeticity is unchecked (G4), and a native Run
tool's channel is checked by nobody (G19). A Run tool hosted as Wasm reaches only its declared target (I44); dev hosts none.
build-bundle.sh: policies/ → OPA WASM bundles/<revision>.tar.gz; revision = SHA-256 over sorted non-test .rego
dev-init.sh signs a copy into dev/bundles/ with <revision>.sig under a dev bundle key whose public half the rules carry
in bundle_keys; the tracked tarball stays unsigned. Signing at promotion is a script step (G7 item 67).
break_glass: two roster keys, quorum 2, the demo tool, actions ["Actuate"]
erasure_roster: null (as genesis rules issue none)
verifier_keys: [] (read at rung 3, so none is granted) · bundle_keys: the dev bundle key
No seat declares a rung (0 by default); personas empty; criterion unset (G2)
Every spec/*.tla, copied into dev/corpus/ under its SHA-256: the content-addressed Read store
id, peers 127.0.0.1:7101–7103, data dir, both sockets, rules, params, corpus, bundles dir, opa_sidecar, kafka, the tool spec with its binary SHA-256
Every generated secret, in the clear

topak check-rules validates rules.json against the rules floor at the end of dev-init.sh, and every replica refuses rules that violate it at startup: the runtime stand-in for the unwritten GenesisSatisfiesFloor.

text.tspan: How it is checked, and how it stays honest

svg.text: mutations.rs, confinement.rs (core), sim.rs (Paxos deterministic simulation with Voting invariants), floor.rs,
fallback.rs (bundle tier, signatures), e2e.rs, contain.rs (the launcher in the node), launch.rs, wasmtool.rs (
TLA+ properties restated as Rust tests with the same mutations.
TOPAK_TRACE_DIR makes every apply write a step: index, entry, result and a projected state (trace.rs).
trace2tla.py converts; mechanism-trace-run.sh replays in TLC.
2026.10.02: 62 traces, 709 steps, every step matching, each state also read against Confinement_A1's invariants
(ConfinementRefinement). A mechanized link, not a refinement; T-0045-28 stays a trust root.

text.tspan: Corpus pins and the drift test

svg.text: corpus-pins.sha256: 49 pins, one per record and TLA+ module the reference follows.
cargo test -p topak-core --test drift fails when a pinned file changes, or when the code cites a record that
is not pinned. PROVISIONAL (<tag>) marks every gap in the code.
scripts/smoke.py: processes, TCP, operator CLI and an MCP client, in-memory or against Kafka and the sidecar.

text.tspan: What it does not show (ToO §15; ADR-0033 §6; the register, as at G9)
What stands in, and what that leaves

svg.text: The launcher makes the alphabet the whole channel for a guest it starts; no guest it starts passes P3, no host it runs on attests (rung 3 is SIMULATED, rung 2 a seam), and an agent outside a launcher still has a shell
Tools are pinned by binary and schema and run in a cleared environment; their behaviour is unchecked

A Wasm-hosted Run tool reaches only its declared target; a native one is checked by nobody, the channel is declared twice and not checked to agree, and a P4-pass Build profile is not held to Wasm tools
One is seated, its heartbeats are heard and its absence stalls; the Observer that would produce a finding is an e2e fixture with nothing behind it

text.tspan: The archive and the plaintext store

svg.text: archive.jsonl per replica is a projection of the log; no governed store, no horizon, no audit-authority read path
Not implemented; no erasure roster exists, so X2-erasure admits nothing
For an operator grant, persona is an operator-supplied digest; a launch's appraisal must name the profile's, which is all the rung detects
Dev rules, not genesis rules; no anchor ceremony
None; scale and long-running behaviour are not shown
Plain TCP between replicas; socket file modes and bearer tokens
A script step under a dev key with custody (1, 0); no pipeline, no custody row

text.tspan: That the floor is the right floor

svg.text: The rung-1 launcher, a SIMULATED rung 3, the session proof, Contained as a lookup, and the Run tool host for Wasm modules: built, under addenda that are pending (A7, A8) on records that are not ratified (ADR-0036; ADR-0034 A2)
